split.paper_protocol_summary: Per-project chronological sort; top 80% commits train, remaining 20% test; combine across projects (ESEC/FSE 2022 §6.1).
split.validation_file_provenance: Materialized changes_valid.pkl / features_valid.pkl referenced by replication README; exact carve vs train REQUIRES_ACQUISITION_PHASE (no generation script found in repo).

labels.commit_positive_semantics: Positive commit label means defect-inducing / buggy commit (JIT-DP). Paper: identifying defect-inducing commits. Code: label cast to int; defective when label==1.
labels.line_positive_semantics: Positive line label means defect-inducing / buggy line in the defect-introducing commit representation. Upstream line-label README exposes added_buggy_level per added line; evaluation code treats label==1 as buggy.
labels.line_label_scope_notes: Paper constructs labels via bug-fixing deleted lines mapped to bug-inducing commits; unlabeled lines in BICs treated as clean. Replication eval uses --only_adds to restrict ranking/effort to added lines. Exact added_buggy_level coding REQUIRES_ACQUISITION_PHASE inspection of pickle/JSON.

license.evidence: No LICENSE/COPYING in jacknichao/JIT-Fine at frozen revision; GitHub license metadata null; paper does not state a dataset redistribution license in inspected text.
